title: CommuDAO
tagline: A Tool to create and manage DAOs across multiple chains. It uses Chainlink CCIP for managing cross chain voting on proposals and  WorldCoin in order to verify people.
description:
Our innovative tool empowers users to create and manage decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) across multiple blockchain networks seamlessly. By leveraging Chainlink's Cross Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP), we enable a truly decentralized and interoperable DAO ecosystem where anyone can deploy their DAO on any blockchain they prefer.

Our platform allows users to effortlessly create their own DAOs and deploy them on their chosen blockchain. Whether it's Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain, Polygon, or any other supported network, users have the freedom to select the chain that best suits their needs. This flexibility ensures that DAOs can operate in environments that align with their specific requirements, whether that be low fees, high security, or particular community preferences.

Chainlink's CCIP enables secure and efficient cross-chain communication, allowing DAO members to vote on proposals from any chain. This cross-chain voting mechanism ensures that all members of the DAO, regardless of the blockchain they operate on, can participate in governance decisions. It truly democratizes the decision-making process, making it a decentralized system where every voice can be heard, no matter where it's located.

To ensure the integrity of the DAO ecosystem, we have integrated WorldCoin’s WorldID for identity verification. Before users can create or join a DAO, or even participate in voting on proposals, they must verify themselves using WorldID. This verification process helps prevent malicious actors from infiltrating the system and ensures that governance processes remain secure and trustworthy. It also adds an additional layer of trust within the community by ensuring that all participants are verified individuals.

Our tool is designed to support the vision of a truly decentralized and interoperable world. By combining cross-chain capabilities with robust identity verification, we offer a solution that transcends the limitations of traditional single-chain DAOs. This creates a dynamic, interconnected ecosystem where DAOs can operate across multiple networks while maintaining a unified governance structure.

The platform offers an intuitive interface for users to easily manage their DAOs, including setting up governance rules, deploying smart contracts, and monitoring activity across chains. For developers, we provide comprehensive APIs and SDKs to integrate additional functionalities or customize their DAOs further, making the platform versatile for a wide range of applications.
how_its_made:
So, we used Foundry to build, test, and deploy smart contracts. The front end is built using Next.js, Tailwind and Typescript. We used Chainlink's CCIP for inter-chain communication needed for voting. WorldID was used for Verification.

It took us some time, as there did not exist a Cross Chain DAO System such as this before, so we had to brainstorm a lot of ideas on how we would make it work.

In the end, we got it and made a basic prototype of what could be a robust cross-chain DAO creation and management tool.
